sandboxes_dev_server_ready_check.name: sandboxes_dev_server_ready_check
sandboxes_dev_server_ready_check.value: ("sandboxes"."dev_server_status" in ('starting', 'ready')) = ("sandboxes"."dev_server_port" is not null and "sandboxes"."dev_server_lease_expires_at" is not null)

sandboxes_lifecycle_snapshot_metadata_ch.name: sandboxes_lifecycle_snapshot_metadata_check
sandboxes_lifecycle_snapshot_metadata_ch.value: ("sandboxes"."lifecycle_snapshot_id" is null and "sandboxes"."lifecycle_snapshot_sha256" is null and "sandboxes"."lifecycle_snapshot_size_bytes" is null) or ("sandboxes"."lifecycle_snapshot_id" is not null and "sandboxes"."lifecycle_snapshot_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "sandboxes"."lifecycle_snapshot_size_bytes" > 0)
